verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's first-project guide walks through creating a project and an index, adding documents, and running a first search in the web interface, and local install is a single cURL command for a dependency-free binary. Hands-on reports back the speed claim: one user had it indexing and searching within 30 minutes with zero config. One user said building a full index, upload and settings integration took about a week of coding, which concerns a production build rather than the quickstart. missing for 10: explicit documented timing for the quickstart flow itself, and corroboration that the API/SDK quickstart path (not just the cloud web UI) runs in minutes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an index, add documents, and run my first search within minutes of starting the quickstart

citations.quote: setting up Meilisearch Cloud, creating a project and an index, adding documents to it, and performing your first search with the default web interface
Adding search to your website takes minutes, not months.
